puzzle.hint: There is exactly one spy among the players.

statements.speaker: Player A
statements.text: at least one of the following is true: (1) at least 2 of Player A and Player B are knaves; (2) Player A and Player B have the same role.

statements.speaker: Player B
statements.text: it is not the case that (at least 0 of Player A and Player F are spies).

statements.speaker: Player C
statements.text: it is not the case that (at most 1 of Player A, Player B, Player C, Player E, and Player F are spies).

statements.speaker: Player D
statements.text: it is not the case that (Player B and Player C have the same role).

statements.speaker: Player E
statements.text: it is not the case that (Player A is a knight).

statements.speaker: Player F
statements.text: at most 2 of Player C, Player D, Player E, and Player F are knights.

fields.text: B and C's statements are always false, so they are knaves (or spy). Assuming they are knaves, D's statement becomes false, making D a knave. A cannot be knight because his statement would be false, so A is knave. Then E's statement is true, allowing E to be the spy. F's statement is true, so F is knight. Exactly one spy (E) and all constraints satisfied.

Derived that B's statement is false so B is knave. C's false statement makes C knave. D then must be knave. A's statement reduces to A and B same role, so A cannot be knave; choose A as spy. E's statement true makes E knight. F's statement true makes F knight. All constraints satisfied.

B and C statements are always false, so they are knaves (or one could be spy). Assuming A is the spy avoids contradictions. Then D's statement is false (B and C same role) so D knave. E's claim that A is not a knight is true, making E a knight. F must be knight to keep his at‑most‑2‑knights claim true. All roles fit the single‑spy requirement.

A’s statement is true only if A and B share role; with B knave this forces A to be spy (truth value free). E’s claim that A is not a knight is true, so E is knight. F’s claim that at most two of C,D,E,F are knights is true (only E and F), so F is knight. Exactly one spy (A) and all constraints satisfied.

Exactly one spy (A) and all constraints satisfied.
